title: Zesty French Olive Skillet
description: A fresh and molten French dish featuring castelvetrano olives, perfect for a brunch mood. This lacto-vegetarian friendly dish is inspired by the cuisine of Alsace.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the cubed bread to the skillet and cook until it is lightly toasted.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the bread mixture in the skillet.
Sprinkle the shredded gruyere cheese over the top of the egg mixture.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with the pitted castelvetrano olives and chopped parsley.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
